describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal hybrid shown in right-facing profile, with the overall body, head and limbs of a brown bear combined with parts of a large beetle. It is covered in dense shaggy brown fur that is lighter on the muzzle and darker on the legs, stands on four thick bear legs with clawed paws, has a bear's head with a blunt snout and small rounded ears, and bears glossy dark reddish-brown beetle wing-covers on its neck, chest and side, two large translucent membranous insect wings with brown veining protruding from the sides of its torso, rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur on its flank and hindquarter, and a segmented armored tail ending in a small fork.

describe.description: A quadrupedal creature with the body, head, fur, legs and paws of a brown bear standing in three-quarter view facing right. Its brown shaggy fur covers the torso, head and four thick legs. Fused into the shoulders, neck and chest are multiple glossy dark reddish-brown beetle wing-covers with large translucent veined membranous insect wings extending outward from the sides. The rear bears a long segmented glossy dark arthropod tail curving downward ending in two claws, and the flanks have rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur.
